label: Analysis of the prevalence and risk factors of post-intensive-care syndrome and post-sepsis syndrome in survivors of sepsis.
summary: ObjectiveIn the intensive care unit (ICU), sepsis is a leading cause of mortality, and survivors frequently experience serious long-term sequelae.
